tasks.gr10-computer-systems-file-management: Topic: Computer systems and file management. Cover types of computers, data and information, desktop GUI, access control, drives, folders, files, naming conventions, hardware and software. Ask about MCQs on hardware/software, file-organisation tasks, shortcut questions.
tasks.gr10-word-processing-fundamentals: Topic: Word processing fundamentals. Cover workspace, document structure, text entry, editing, formatting, paragraph/page layout, proofing, illustrations. Ask about screen-based practical tasks, formatting fixes, word-processing concepts.
tasks.gr10-ergonomics-green-computing-t1: Topic: Ergonomics and Green Computing. Cover a healthy workstation, health issues (eye strain, RSI, posture), correct keyboarding habits, and green computing practices. Ask Grade 10 learners to give a way to prevent a problem or a green practice.
